name: pitcher
frame: Z-up, metres, base at z=0, bbox centred in x/y, handle along +x

target.why: Brita 6-10 cup pitchers are 25-26 cm tall (e.g. Everyday 10-cup 26.2 cm); 25 cm chosen

y_rescale.why: photo is a pure side view, so SAM 3D had to guess the depth (17.5 cm, a round body); Brita 10-cup pitchers are 26.9 x 14.0 x 26.2 cm (L x W x H), so y is rescaled to 13.5 cm

notes: Brita-style filter pitcher (clear plastic in the photo; SAM 3D colours it grey-white). Visual has the lid; collision is open-topped (lid removed above 90% height), walls 4 mm, spout at -x, handle +x. Depth set from Brita proportions (see Size choices). A string tied round the handle in the photo was trimmed and painted grey; a ~1.5 cm frayed bump remains under the handle's lower arm. The visual's bottom ~3 cm is solid (SAM 3D read the water in the photo as solid); the collision cavity ignores it. Seed 42 kept over seed 7 (seed 7's lid was a flat disc).
